name: @infra/watchdog
description: Recreates unhealthy or restart-looping compose containers on the VM. The daemon is Rust (backend/watchdog); its flow tests drive the run loop in-process (backend/watchdog/rs/tests/flow.rs). Its unit tests also cover the scripts of the agent-shell image (`../agent-shell/tests`), which have no package of their own: a TypeScript package outside frontend/ is not allowed.
